title: BunusRadar AI Coding Assistant Benchmark 2026
referenceHardware: AWS us-east-1 c6i.4xlarge (16 vCPU, 32 GB RAM, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS)
methodology: 50 standardized programming tasks across 5 repositories (TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Next.js). Evaluated on task completion rate, introduced syntax or logic bugs, median execution latency, cost per task, and hallucination rate.
